tier_should.rationale: Strong, policy-relevant meta-analysis of 52 RCTs estimating child mortality effects and cost-effectiveness; rigorous methods increase power; credible team; novel evidence fills key gap; best fit is top field/global health journal.

tier_will.rationale: High-profile authors and policy relevance favor placement in Lancet Global Health or top field econ/health journal; meta-analysis format may deter top-five general; still strong odds of near-A placement.
